U0.name: Penyimpanan Geometris Berbasis Konten (MCard CAS)
U0.description: Lapisan atom posisi spasial dan batas primitif; unit kebenaran bentuk sebelum ada pergerakan.

CoordinateVertex.name: Verteks Koordinat (x, y)
CoordinateVertex.desc: Titik posisi diskrit dalam ruang manifold Euclidean; jangkar pertama penetapan lokasi.
CoordinateVertex.metaphor: Patok bambu pertama yang ditancapkan di sudut sawah adat.

SimplexFacet.name: Faset Simpleks (Garis Tepi)
SimplexFacet.desc: Ruas batas 1-dimensi yang menghubungkan dua verteks; dinding primitif pembatas ruang.
SimplexFacet.metaphor: Tali ijuk yang direntangkan lurus antara dua patok batas sawah.

SpatialContentId.name: Pengidentifikasi Konten Spasial (CID)
SpatialContentId.desc: Sidik jari kriptografis (hash SHA-256) dari susunan jaring spasial yang tak dapat dimanipulasi.
SpatialContentId.metaphor: Peta batas tanah desa berstempel cap segel tembaga lurah adat.

EuclideanDistanceMetric.name: Metrik Jarak Euclidean
EuclideanDistanceMetric.desc: Jarak terpendek matematis antar dua titik posisi; dasar kalkulasi regangan dan tegangan batas.
EuclideanDistanceMetric.metaphor: Langkah kaki tetua desa saat mengukur lebar pematang sawah.

U1.name: Perambatan Garis & Mesin Keadaan Spasial (PCard CPN)
U1.desc: Lapisan lintasan dinamis yang merajut titik-titik lepas menjadi keliling batas terhubung.

GeodesicPathSegment.name: Segmen Lintasan Geodesik
GeodesicPathSegment.desc: Transisi garis terpendek antar verteks yang membatasi wilayah luar dan dalam.
GeodesicPathSegment.metaphor: Gundukan tanah pematang sawah yang menghubungkan dua sudut petak sawah.

PerimeterTracerStep.name: Langkah Penelusur Keliling
PerimeterTracerStep.desc: Langkah penelusuran berurutan berlawanan arah jarum jam untuk memverifikasi keterhubungan rantai.
PerimeterTracerStep.metaphor: Ronda malam mengelilingi pagar desa langkah demi langkah tanpa terputus.

KinectDepthProjector.name: Proyektor Kedalaman Sensor (Kinect)
KinectDepthProjector.desc: Pengubah pindaian bayangan cahaya inframerah menjadi sebaran titik spasial nyata.
KinectDepthProjector.metaphor: Sorot obor malam hari yang menampakkan lekuk bukit dan lembah.

U2.name: Bukti Penutupan Topologis & Hukum Bentuk (VCard Proof)
U2.desc: Lapisan penjaga keutuhan topologis; membuktikan batas tertutup rapat tanpa celah bocor.

GaussBonnetClosureProof.name: Bukti Penutupan Gauss-Bonnet
GaussBonnetClosureProof.desc: Bukti formal bahwa jumlah sudut luar sama dengan 2π (360°); menjamin kurva tertutup sempurna.
GaussBonnetClosureProof.metaphor: Lingkaran pagar bambu yang ujung akhirnya menyatu kembali ke tiang pangkal awal.

IsoperimetricBoundProof.name: Bukti Batas Isoperimetrik (Q ≤ 1)
IsoperimetricBoundProof.desc: Bukti efisiensi ruang: luas area terlindung maksimal terhadap panjang keliling pematang.
IsoperimetricBoundProof.metaphor: Kendi tanah liat bundar yang memuat air paling banyak dengan bahan tanah paling hemat.

JordanCurveContainmentProof.name: Bukti Kurva Jordan (Pencegah Bocor)
JordanCurveContainmentProof.desc: Bukti bahwa bilangan dan aset berada kokoh di dalam (winding number = 1), aman dari geseran termal.
JordanCurveContainmentProof.metaphor: Beras lumbung yang aman tersimpan di dalam lumbung berdinding rapat.

U3.name: Jala Sensorik & Akustik Spasial (Satori Speech Acts)
U3.desc: Umpan balik persepsi dan suara gema spasial yang memberi tahu kondisi keutuhan batas.

TopologicalParallaxPulse.name: Denyut Paralaks Kedalaman
TopologicalParallaxPulse.desc: Sinyal suara stereo berfrekuensi dinamis yang mencerminkan kedalaman dan jarak ruang.
TopologicalParallaxPulse.metaphor: Suara gema langkah kaki di lorong bambu yang menunjukkan jarak dinding.

BoundaryDefectAlert.name: Peringatan Celah Robekan Batas
BoundaryDefectAlert.desc: Tindak tutur peringatan saat ada sudut yang terbuka dan token mulai terancam bocor.
BoundaryDefectAlert.metaphor: Teriakan ronda malam: 'Pematang jebol! Air meluap!'

CellEnclosureChime.name: Denting Harmoni Penutupan Sel
CellEnclosureChime.desc: Suara genta gamelan merdu yang berdentang saat kurva menutup sempurna 2π.
CellEnclosureChime.metaphor: Gong ageng berbunyi saat upacara pembukaan pagar desa adat selesai didirikan.

U4.name: Membran Kanvas Antarmuka Spasial (Membrane UI)
U4.desc: Antarmuka visual dan sentuhan tempat pengguna merancang dan menutup perimeter ruang.

TopographicCanvasViewport.name: Viewport Kanvas Topografi
TopographicCanvasViewport.desc: Bale panggung MCard visual tempat titik-titik dan garis geometri dibentangkan secara interaktif.
TopographicCanvasViewport.metaphor: Kain layar mori wayang kulit tempat peta mandala desa digambarkan.

VertexPlacementTrigger.name: Pemicu Titik Sudut
VertexPlacementTrigger.desc: Aksi klik atau sentuhan tangan untuk menancapkan verteks batas baru pada kanvas.
VertexPlacementTrigger.metaphor: Menancapkan tonggak bambu baru ke dalam tanah lembap.

CurvatureDefectGauge.name: Meteran Defek Kelengkungan
CurvatureDefectGauge.desc: Indikator visual melingkar yang menampilkan kemajuan sudut menuju 2π dan luas tertutup.
CurvatureDefectGauge.metaphor: Busur derajat perunggu pembuat candi penunjuk keseimbangan empat penjuru.

U5.name: Lingkar Pembelajaran Spasial Meta-Sirkuler (Loop Γ)
U5.desc: Tingkat kognisi tertinggi; menjaga intuisi bentuk mengalir alami dan ruang batin tetap terbuka.

SpatialGASingFlowState.name: GASing Keheningan Spasial
SpatialGASingFlowState.desc: Keadaan fokus bermain: menggambar titik itu gampang, melingkari batas itu asyik, memiliki suaka berdaulat itu menyenangkan.
SpatialGASingFlowState.metaphor: Bermain membangun istana pasir yang kokoh di pantai bersama sahabat desa.

TopologicalFitness.name: Kebugaran Topologis
TopologicalFitness.desc: Indeks efisiensi geometri: perbandingan luas terlindung terhadap ongkos pemeliharaan pematang.
TopologicalFitness.metaphor: Sawah terasering yang paling subur dengan tanggul yang paling kuat tahan banjir.

KenoticSpatialVoid.name: Ruang Kosong Kenosis
KenoticSpatialVoid.desc: Manifold kosong tanpa asumsi prasangka yang siap menerima bentuk arsitektur apapun.
KenoticSpatialVoid.metaphor: Halaman pura desa yang bersih lapang, siap menampung seluruh warga saat upacara adat.

U0.name: स्थान-निरूपित-स्थित-संग्रहः (MCard CAS)
U0.description: अनपवर्त्यं स्थान-परमाणु-तत्त्वम्; सर्व-क्रियाभ्यः पूर्वं नित्यतया सिद्ध-सीमा।

U1.name: सीमा-परिभ्रमण-क्रिया-चक्रम् (PCard CPN)
U1.desc: गतिशीला रेखा-धारा; पृथक्-बिन्दून् संयोग्य अविच्छिन्नां सीमां रचयति।

U3.name: दिक्-ध्वनि-वाग्-व्यवहारः (Satori Speech Acts)
U3.desc: स्थान-स्थिति-द्योतकाः संवेद्य-शब्दाः ये सीमायाः अखण्डतां ज्ञापयन्ति।

BoundaryDefectAlert.name: सीमा-भेद-चेतना
BoundaryDefectAlert.metaphor: रक्षकस्य उच्चैः-क्रोशः : 'पाली भग्ना! तोयं स्रवति!' इति।

U4.name: स्थान-चित्र-पटलम् (Membrane UI)
U4.desc: दृष्टि-गोचर-पटलम् यत्र साधकः स्वायत्तां सीमां चित्रयति संवृणोति च।

TopographicCanvasViewport.name: स्थान-चित्र-मण्डपम्
TopographicCanvasViewport.desc: चित्र-पटलम् यत्र स्थान-बिन्दवः सीमा-रेखाश्च प्रत्यक्षं दृश्यन्ते।

U5.name: परम-संविद्-परिक्रमः (Loop Γ)
U5.desc: अनन्त-स्थान-ज्ञान-परिवर्तः; शून्यात् आकारं, आकारात् पुनः शुद्ध-शान्तिम् आनयति।

SpatialGASingFlowState.name: GASing स्थान-समाधिः
SpatialGASingFlowState.desc: स्थान-रचने सुखम्; बिन्दु-पाते सुलभता, वेष्टने रतिः, स्व-क्षेत्रे च महा-शान्तिः।

KenoticSpatialVoid.name: शून्य-स्थान-पात्रम्
KenoticSpatialVoid.desc: अपरिगृहीतं शून्य-स्थानम् यत् कामपि नूतनाम् आकृतिं धारयितुं समर्थम्।
KenoticSpatialVoid.metaphor: निर्मलं शुभाङ्गणं यत् सर्व-जनानां संमेलनाय सज्जम्।

U0.name: Content-Addressed Spatial Storage (MCard CAS)
U0.description: Irreducible geometric atomic layer; objective spatial truth prior to dynamic transformations.

CoordinateVertex.name: Coordinate Vertex
CoordinateVertex.desc: Discrete point position in 2D/3D Euclidean manifold; the foundational spatial anchor.
CoordinateVertex.metaphor: The first boundary stake driven into virgin communal farmland.

SimplexFacet.name: Simplex Facet (Edge)
SimplexFacet.desc: 1-dimensional boundary segment connecting two vertices; primitive enclosing wall.
SimplexFacet.metaphor: A taut boundary rope stretched between two corner stakes.

SpatialContentId.name: Spatial Content Identifier (CID)
SpatialContentId.desc: Cryptographic hash of the topological mesh guaranteeing tamper-proof spatial blueprints.
SpatialContentId.metaphor: An immutable surveyor's seal etched onto an official land deed.

EuclideanDistanceMetric.name: Euclidean Distance Metric
EuclideanDistanceMetric.desc: Geodesic flat distance between coordinate anchors; basis for tension and perimeter measures.
EuclideanDistanceMetric.metaphor: The village elder's paced steps measuring the field perimeter.

U1.name: Spatial Transitions & Boundary Tracing (PCard CPN)
U1.desc: Dynamic pathway layer connecting scattered points into continuous enclosing perimeters.

GeodesicPathSegment.name: Geodesic Path Segment
GeodesicPathSegment.desc: Shortest transition path between boundary vertices establishing inner vs outer domain.
GeodesicPathSegment.metaphor: An earthen terrace bund running straight between two irrigation corners.

PerimeterTracerStep.name: Perimeter Tracer Step
PerimeterTracerStep.desc: Counterclockwise traversal step verifying sequential topological connectivity.
PerimeterTracerStep.metaphor: A night watchman patrolling the village rampart step by contiguous step.

KinectDepthProjector.name: Kinect Depth Projector
KinectDepthProjector.desc: Functor transforming structured infrared reflections into 3D metric point clouds.
KinectDepthProjector.metaphor: A lantern beam illuminating the contours of an unfamiliar cave wall.

U2.name: Topological Closure Proofs & Invariants (VCard Proof)
U2.desc: Verification layer proving leak-free topological closure and perimeter efficiency.

GaussBonnetClosureProof.name: Gauss-Bonnet Closure Proof
GaussBonnetClosureProof.desc: Formal proof that total exterior angular turning equals 2π; guarantees loop closure.
GaussBonnetClosureProof.metaphor: A boundary palisade whose final post locks seamlessly into the first gatepost.

IsoperimetricBoundProof.name: Isoperimetric Bound Proof (Q ≤ 1)
IsoperimetricBoundProof.desc: Proof of maximum enclosed area per unit of perimeter cost; optimal membrane tension.
IsoperimetricBoundProof.metaphor: A round clay pot holding maximum water with minimal clay expenditure.

JordanCurveContainmentProof.name: Jordan Curve Containment Proof
JordanCurveContainmentProof.desc: Topological winding proof (wind = 1) guaranteeing internal tokens cannot leak into void.
JordanCurveContainmentProof.metaphor: Grain sealed inside a granary wall, entirely protected from the blowing storm.

U3.name: Sensory Synesthesia & Auditory Geometry (Satori Speech Acts)
U3.desc: Acoustic and speech-act feedback communicating topological integrity and spatial depth.

TopologicalParallaxPulse.name: Topological Parallax Pulse
TopologicalParallaxPulse.desc: Stereo auditory pulse whose frequency shifts dynamically with distance and depth coordinates.
TopologicalParallaxPulse.metaphor: Footstep echoes reverberating down a bamboo colonnade revealing wall distances.

BoundaryDefectAlert.name: Boundary Defect Alert
BoundaryDefectAlert.desc: Warning directive speech act firing when an open perimeter risks token evacuation.
BoundaryDefectAlert.metaphor: The night guard's sudden cry: 'The bund is broken! Water is spilling!'

CellEnclosureChime.name: Cell Enclosure Chime
CellEnclosureChime.desc: Resonant gamelan gong chime triggered at the instant the perimeter closes to 2π.
CellEnclosureChime.metaphor: The deep ceremonial bronze gong sounding as the village fence is consecrated.

U4.name: Topographic Canvas Interface (Membrane UI)
U4.desc: Visual and tactile surface where agents design, enclose, and monitor spatial domains.

TopographicCanvasViewport.name: Topographic Canvas Viewport
TopographicCanvasViewport.desc: Interactive HTML5 viewport rendering vertices, edges, enclosed fields, and stress lines.
TopographicCanvasViewport.metaphor: The white linen canvas where the sacred village mandala blueprint is drafted.

VertexPlacementTrigger.name: Vertex Placement Trigger
VertexPlacementTrigger.desc: Tactile click or pointer interaction driving boundary node anchor placement.
VertexPlacementTrigger.metaphor: Driving a fresh boundary stake firmly into the damp soil.

CurvatureDefectGauge.name: Curvature Defect Gauge
CurvatureDefectGauge.desc: Circular telemetry dial monitoring cumulative angle turn towards 2π and enclosed area.
CurvatureDefectGauge.metaphor: A master mason's bronze radial quadrant certifying structural squareness.

U5.name: Meta-Circular Continuous Spatial Learning (Loop Γ)
U5.desc: Highest epistemic stratum; cultivating intuitive geometric flow and unconstrained spatial schemas.

SpatialGASingFlowState.name: Spatial GASing Flow State
SpatialGASingFlowState.desc: Playful mastery: placing points is Easy, closing loops is Fun, sovereign sanctuary is Enjoyable.
SpatialGASingFlowState.metaphor: Children collaboratively carving an impregnable sand fortress on a tranquil shore.

TopologicalFitness.name: Topological Fitness
TopologicalFitness.desc: Structural quality metric: ratio of protected enclosed area to perimeter construction and defect cost.
TopologicalFitness.metaphor: A terraced hillside maximizing rice yield with minimal wall erosion.

KenoticSpatialVoid.name: Kenotic Spatial Void
KenoticSpatialVoid.desc: An unconditioned coordinate manifold capable of hosting any morphology without preconceptions.
KenoticSpatialVoid.metaphor: The serene empty courtyard of a sanctuary ready to welcome all pilgrims.

meta.latticeTitle: CLM 類型格（Type Lattice）：第 02 章

U0.name: 空間定址靜態儲存層（MCard CAS）
U0.description: 不可約簡之空間原子幾何層；在任何形變前已確鑿存在的位置基底。

CoordinateVertex.name: 座標頂點原子
CoordinateVertex.desc: 二維／三維歐幾里得流形中的離散定位點，為空間安界之基點。
CoordinateVertex.metaphor: 農田邊界上打下的第一根界樁木橛。

SimplexFacet.name: 單體邊界刻面（Edge）
SimplexFacet.desc: 連結兩頂點之一維幾何線段，構築圍成空間之基元壁壘。
SimplexFacet.metaphor: 兩木橛間拉起的第一道浸油墨線。

SpatialContentId.name: 空間內容識別碼（CID）
SpatialContentId.desc: 基於加密雜湊之網格藍圖唯一指紋，確保地籍空間不容篡改。
SpatialContentId.metaphor: 官府地契上不可塗抹之硃砂方印。

EuclideanDistanceMetric.name: 歐幾里得距離度量
EuclideanDistanceMetric.desc: 兩點間之平直最短距離測度，為張力與周長計算之物理基準。
EuclideanDistanceMetric.metaphor: 司空測繪時手中緊握之銅尺引線。

U1.name: 空間躍遷與邊界追蹤層（PCard CPN）
U1.desc: 將散立頂點連綴成連續閉合周界的動態路徑演進層。

GeodesicPathSegment.name: 測地路徑分段
GeodesicPathSegment.desc: 相鄰兩頂點間的最短路徑躍遷，界定空間之內外分野。
GeodesicPathSegment.metaphor: 田畝兩端隆起之夯土田埂。

PerimeterTracerStep.name: 周界逆時針追蹤步進
PerimeterTracerStep.desc: 依序巡行邊界各單元，驗證多邊形鏈條之拓撲連續性。
PerimeterTracerStep.metaphor: 夜間守望者沿城垛巡視，步步相連。

KinectDepthProjector.name: 深度感測投影器（Kinect）
KinectDepthProjector.desc: 將結構光紅外反射圖轉換為客觀三維點雲之空間函子。
KinectDepthProjector.metaphor: 持火把照徹暗室，使遠近深淺凹凸頓現。

U2.name: 拓撲閉合證明與空間不變量（VCard Proof）
U2.desc: 幾何不變量檢驗層；以純邏輯證明周界嚴密無間、無漏無缺。

GaussBonnetClosureProof.name: 高斯-博內閉合定理證明
GaussBonnetClosureProof.desc: 嚴格證明外角偏轉總和恆等於 2π；確保空間周界拓撲閉合無漏。
GaussBonnetClosureProof.metaphor: 環村竹籬環環相扣，終點嚴絲合縫鎖入起點門柱。

IsoperimetricBoundProof.name: 等周定理極限證明（Q ≤ 1）
IsoperimetricBoundProof.desc: 證明單位周界長度下包圍面積之最大效率比，體現膜張力極優解。
IsoperimetricBoundProof.metaphor: 圓潤之陶罐，以最省之黏土包容最深廣之甘泉。

JordanCurveContainmentProof.name: 若爾當曲線內在包孕證明
JordanCurveContainmentProof.desc: 以卷繞數（wind = 1）證明數據代幣完全居於內部，抵禦外在剪切流。
JordanCurveContainmentProof.metaphor: 穀物深藏於密實倉廩，暴風驟雨莫之能侵。

U3.name: 空間聯覺與聽覺拓撲層（Satori Speech Acts）
U3.desc: 以聲音共振與語篇反饋即時傳達邊界完整度與景深感知之知覺層。

TopologicalParallaxPulse.name: 拓撲視差深度脈衝
TopologicalParallaxPulse.desc: 頻率隨三維景深動態變異之雙耳立體聲，將幾何距離轉化為音高感官。
TopologicalParallaxPulse.metaphor: 足音迴盪於深巷，依回音高低辨析兩側高牆遠近。

BoundaryDefectAlert.name: 邊界穿孔警報言語
BoundaryDefectAlert.desc: 當周界存在裂口、內部資產面臨逸散時觸發之警示言語行為。
BoundaryDefectAlert.metaphor: 更夫驟發長呼：「堤防潰決！快堵缺口！」

CellEnclosureChime.name: 細胞閉合共鳴鐘聲
CellEnclosureChime.desc: 在周界旋轉角完滿閉合至 2π 之瞬間奏響之深沉甘美朗銅鑼磬音。
CellEnclosureChime.metaphor: 界樁落鎖、合龍竣工時，城頭鳴動之平安大梵鐘。

U4.name: 地形畫布空間介面層（Membrane UI）
U4.desc: 供觀測者親手布設頂點、連綴封閉周界並直觀感知之擬物化視窗。

TopographicCanvasViewport.name: 拓撲畫布視窗（MCard Viewport）
TopographicCanvasViewport.desc: 以 HTML5 Canvas 即時繪製頂點、測地線段、受護面積與應力線之交互空間。
TopographicCanvasViewport.metaphor: 工匠繪製村落風水堪輿圖所鋪展之雪白絹帛。

VertexPlacementTrigger.name: 頂點置放觸發器
VertexPlacementTrigger.desc: 點擊畫布以落錨全新邊界節點之觸覺交互事件。
VertexPlacementTrigger.metaphor: 於界線關鍵折角處重重釘下一枚鐵心木樁。

CurvatureDefectGauge.name: 曲率偏轉儀表盤
CurvatureDefectGauge.desc: 實時監測累計外角偏轉是否達成 2π 及封閉防護面積之儀表盤。
CurvatureDefectGauge.metaphor: 營造法式中校驗九宮方圓之青銅規矩羅盤。

U5.name: 元循環持續空間學習層（Loop Γ）
U5.desc: 最高階之形意自省層；維持幾何心流直覺與虛己納形之空無模式。

SpatialGASingFlowState.name: 空間 GASing 心流共振態
SpatialGASingFlowState.desc: 落點極簡（Gampang）、合圍至趣（Asyik）、自立避難所極樂（Menyenangkan）之共鳴境界。
SpatialGASingFlowState.metaphor: 沙灘上童稚忘機，嬉笑間共築金湯城堡。

TopologicalFitness.name: 拓撲空間適應度指標
TopologicalFitness.desc: 評估幾何構築之性價比：以受護面積對比周界建造維護成本之最優度量。
TopologicalFitness.metaphor: 最宜居之古村落，依山抱水，費省而效弘。

KenoticSpatialVoid.name: 虛空模式（Kenosis 空間虛心容器）
KenoticSpatialVoid.desc: 無任何預設幾何成見之純粹座標真空，能圓融相容萬千拓撲形狀。
KenoticSpatialVoid.metaphor: 太虛無形，而大象隱存；不設偏見，萬象方能來歸。
